title: Corner shower shelf (fixed)
author: xchgre
description:
This is a bathroom organizer, but it can be used for any place, it is my modified version of the original author that had a significant flaw in one of the walls, both models have the **Public Domain license**, my model is the fixed version of the original. Enjoy.

bathroomshelf shelf bathroomorganizer bathroom voronoi

meta.profile_notes: Slightly smaller at 150x150 mm, added ironing on top surface to make it easier to keep clean. Printed in PLA.

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
